title: Open Values Presentation Package v1.0
description: One generated file holding everything a site's page layer needs: the navigation tree with a route for every decision, the public wording, the ten page kinds, their test cases and the source index. The presentation build writes it from the files it lists, and the app reads it.

format.description: Names the file format. Always open-values-presentation-package.

version.description: The version of this format the file follows. Always 1.0.0.

built.description: The date of the package, as YYYY-MM-DD, copied from the updated date in the strings file.

consumer.description: The code the package is built for. Currently P5 presentation implementation.

sources.description: Paths of the source files the package was built from: the ontology, strings, page kinds, fixtures and source index.

taxonomy.description: The navigation tree a presentation shell shows, resolved from content/ontology.json, with a route for every decision.

source.description: Path of the file the tree was resolved from. Currently content/ontology.json.

sourceSchema.description: Path of the schema that source file follows.

generatedSource.description: Where the same ontology appears in the generated dataset index, as a path and JSON pointer.

version.description: The version number of the ontology's presentation section.

levels.description: The levels of the tree in order, from need down to entry, each with an id and a label.

leafState.description: The rules for telling a live decision from a gap: a decision with a dataset id (cid) is live, one without is shown as Not yet covered, and how a gap's id is made.

counts.description: Totals for the tree: needs, categories, subcategories, decisions, live paths, live datasets and decisions not yet covered.

needs.description: The needs at the top of the tree, each with its categories and subcategories, and the ids of the decisions under each subcategory.

decisions.description: Every decision in the tree, each with its place in it, its state (live or not-yet-covered), its route, and its dataset id when it has one.

strings.description: The public copy from content/presentation/strings.json, without the format, version and updated fields.

pageKinds.description: The ten page kinds from content/presentation/page-kinds.json, in order.

fixtures.description: The fixture sets from content/presentation/fixtures.json: three test cases for each of the ten page kinds.

scope.description: A sentence saying which sources the index covers.

records.description: The source records, each with its details and the catalogue claims it supports.

checksum.description: A SHA-256 hash of the rest of the package, written as sha256: followed by 64 hex characters.
